project_context.feature_title: Banner click redirects to internal app page & Admin Destination Picker

typography.font_family_mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

customer_carousel_affordance.rule: Banners with links must have a visible affordance that does NOT obstruct the banner art or bottom title gradient
customer_carousel_affordance.cursor: cursor: pointer on slides with promo.link; cursor: default on unlinked slides
customer_carousel_affordance.tap_badge: Subtle top-right micro-pill: 'Tap to view ↗' with backdrop blur (12px), semi-transparent dark pill (rgba(0,0,0,0.42)), 1px white border (rgba(255,255,255,0.25)), micro-arrow icon, font size 11px, hidden when promo.link is falsy
customer_carousel_affordance.touch_interaction: Touch-swipe left/right (>40px diff) triggers slide advance and SUPPRESSES navigation. Touch-tap (diff <= 40px) triggers internal navigation if promo.link exists. suppressNextClick ref prevents duplicate 300ms synthetic click events
customer_carousel_affordance.title_overlay_harmony: Bottom overlay stays pure gradient linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.65)) with white text. Top-right badge balances the composition diagonally without visual collision.

admin_destination_picker.rule: Replace free-text URL input with a standard 5-option dropdown matching existing admin form styles (admin-form-select)
admin_destination_picker.legacy_fallback: If existing banner has a non-matching custom URL, display read-only option 'Custom: {bannerLink}' so previous data is not lost
admin_destination_picker.resolved_path_preview: Show small, clear destination path hint directly below dropdown: '→ /{restaurantId}/menu' in monospace font with muted blue-gray color (#64748B) and high legibility

key_elements.slide: promo-slide (16:9 ratio, relative positioning, role=button when linked, aria-label indicating destination)
key_elements.tap_indicator: promo-tap-indicator (absolute top-2.5 right-2.5, px-2.5 py-1, rounded-full, text-white text-[11px] font-medium, flex items-center gap-1, backdrop-blur-md, pointer-events-none)

accessibility.role: button on interactive slides with link, none on unlinked slides
accessibility.onKeyDown: Enter and Space trigger navigation to promo.link
accessibility.aria_label: Title + 'Tap to open destination' when link is set

key_elements.select: admin-form-select (data-testid='select-bannerLink', full-width, clean border, matches admin-form-input height)
key_elements.preview_line: admin-link-preview (data-testid='banner-link-preview', text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 mt-1 flex items-center gap-1)

instructions_to_main_agent: In /app/frontend/src/components/PromoBanner/PromoBanner.jsx: import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'. Implement suppressNextClick ref (default false).
In onTouchEnd: if Math.abs(diff) <= 40 and active item has a link, set suppressNextClick.current = true and navigate(items[activeIndex].link).
In slide div: add onClick handler that navigates if promo.link exists and suppressNextClick is false. Reset suppressNextClick if true. Add onKeyDown for Enter/Space accessibility.
Add visual affordance: render a delicate pill badge in top-right corner of slide when promo.link exists with text 'Explore ↗' or 'View ↗' and cursor: pointer.
In /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBannersPage.jsx: import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext'. Retrieve user restaurant_id (fallback to user.id).
Define LINK_OPTIONS: No link (''), Full Menu ('/{rid}/menu'), Dining Stations ('/{rid}/stations'), About Us ('/{rid}/about'), Contact ('/{rid}/contact').
Replace input-bannerLink with <select className='admin-form-select' data-testid='select-bannerLink'> containing LINK_OPTIONS plus Custom option for legacy external links.
Render path preview line → {newBanner.bannerLink} when newBanner.bannerLink is non-empty.
Verify no console warnings and clean React build.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not break existing swipe mechanics: diff threshold Math.abs(diff) > 40 MUST remain the swipe threshold.
Prevent synthetic double-clicks using suppressNextClick ref on touch devices.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all) to carousel track or slides. Keep explicit transform transitions.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for badges or overlays. Use semi-transparent dark backgrounds with backdrop blur.
Ensure all test IDs (data-testid) are strictly present as documented.
